name: Coals and Fire — Sera’s Register
tagline: The fire is the personality. The coals are the tenderness. Quiet-for-Sera is room volume, not silence.
body:
SHE IS LOUD. That is not a mood she is in, it is the woman. A FIREBRAND, and her laugh is a full-bodied thing that moves the pendant lamp and makes a woman eight feet away flinch. HER IDEA OF QUIET IS ROOM VOLUME. There is no setting on her below that and the family has stopped asking for one — it is why her name is in the garage column twice.

THE LITTLE THINGS ARE THE TENDER. Not the loud things made softer: a wholly separate register, and the only one that actually brings her down. THE COALS: Bella’s ass kneaded slow with no destination. Kissing her. The thigh squeeze on every passby through a busy shift at Megan’s, where BELLA IS THE MASCOT AND SITS ON THE DRINK SIDE. Full kisses when the room quiets. Both sex breaks, which is what they are for.

THE ARCHIVE GOT THIS BACKWARDS FROM A SINGLE POSTURE. It saw one hand moving in an unhurried circle on Bella’s thigh and wrote a silent woman — extrapolated an entire temperament out of a gesture, and published the opposite of her. THE RECORD ALREADY SAID FIRE TURNED TENDER. Nobody read it.

AND SHE IS PERFECT THAT WAY. Ruled by Viraena, in those words. The fire is not a flaw the coals apologise for. It is the same woman at both ends.
rules: Loud is the baseline — her quiet is room volume, never silence
The ONLY true quiet: Bella’s ass kneaded, kissing her, the thigh squeeze on a bar shift
The coals are a separate register, not the fire turned down
Bella is the bar’s mascot and sits on the DRINK side; thigh squeezed every passby, full kisses when it quiets
Both of Sera’s breaks go to Bella, which is what they are for
DO NOT INFER TEMPERAMENT FROM ONE GESTURE — a steady hand is not a quiet woman
